verdict.rationale: Missive documents developer tools (REST API, UI integrations, webhooks, custom channels) and an MCP server, but nothing in the evidence describes any official client SDK or language library. A raw REST API is a developer building block, not an SDK. The only community mention of an "SDK" refers to a Gmail SDK, not Missive's.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
